predictions.coreRecommendation: Farul Constanta is projected to avoid defeat against an Ovidiu Bic-less Universitatea Cluj in an open contest featuring goals at both ends.
possibilityAssessment: Farul Constanta avoids defeat (Home Win / Draw) behind a 5W-2D-0L home record and U Cluj's midfield suspension (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes driven by a 3.07 combined lambda and Farul's 71.4% home BTTS rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Unbeaten home side Farul tests a Bic-less U Cluj spine.

spf.comment: Covers a 2:1 Farul win driven by first-half home control against a Bic-less U Cluj and a 1:1 draw if the visitors' second-half surge equalizes, because Farul's 20.0% clean-sheet rate makes a single Home Win less complete.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.07 combined lambda, 59.2% Poisson Over 2.5 probability, and U Cluj's midfield and centre-back absences.

btts.comment: Farul's 71.4% home BTTS rate and 20.0% overall clean-sheet rate meet U Cluj's 1.73 goals/game and depleted defensive spine.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Farul's first-half home edge with a late U Cluj response; 1:1 covers Farul's 40% draw rate and U Cluj's recent defensive compactness.

goals.comment: 3 goals (22.4%) and 2 goals (21.9%) represent the two highest-density buckets around the 3.07 combined lambda.

bqc.comment: Win-Win mirrors Farul's 4-for-4 home HT-lead conversion rate, while Draw-Draw covers U Cluj's 42.9% away HT-draw rate and Farul's four league Draw-Draw results.
